    Get in the car

    Four steps. No driver’s license required.

    1. Get a wallet

      Install Phantom or Solflare and save your recovery phrase offline.

    2. Get SOL

      Buy SOL on an exchange and send it to your wallet.

    3. Open a DEX

      Go to a Solana DEX such as Jupiter and connect your wallet.

    4. Swap

      Paste the contract address below, check it matches, then swap SOL for $VICECAT.
